zh.title: 民航局雙十連假離島第二波加班機 9月1日開放訂位
zh.summary: 民航局宣布雙十連假離島第二波加班機於9月1日開放訂位，提供3544個座位。
body: 交通部民用航空局宣布，為因應民眾雙十節連假返鄉及旅遊需求，需求較高之澎湖與金門航線已規劃第二波加班機及放大機型，將於9月1日上午9時起統一開放訂位。此前，雙十節離島管制航線正班機及第一波加班機已於8月10日開放訂位。
民航局指出，第二波加班機及放大機型規劃中，澎湖航線將提供1,016個座位數，金門航線提供2,528個座位數，總計提供3,544個座位數。民航局提醒旅客應依航空公司開票期限完成開票，以利掌握訂位情形並加速清艙作業。
針對尖峰時段機票，民航局表示，10月8日至10月10日臺灣出發往離島方向，以及10月10日至10月12日離島出發回臺灣方向之機票，均會加註限當日當班次與逾期作廢之使用限制，並實施退票費用分級制。

en.title: Taiwan CAA to Open Second-Wave Double Tenth Holiday Flights Booking Sep 1
en.summary: Taiwan's CAA will open second-wave Double Tenth holiday flight bookings on September 1, offering 3,544 extra seats.
body: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration announced that the second wave of additional flights and capacity expansion for Penghu and Kinmen routes during the Double Tenth holiday will open for booking at 9:00 AM on September 1. Regular flights and the initial wave of extra flights for offshore routes were opened on August 10.

The second wave provides 1,016 seats on Penghu routes and 2,528 seats on Kinmen routes, totaling 3,544 seats. The CAA urged passengers to complete ticket issuance according to airline deadlines to ensure their rights and facilitate capacity management.

Tickets for peak periods—from Taiwan to offshore islands between October 8 and 10, and returning from October 10 to 12—will carry restrictions limiting use to the designated date and flight, along with tiered refund fees.

facts.claim: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration announced that the second wave of extra flights for Penghu and Kinmen routes during the Double Tenth holiday will open for booking at 9:00 AM on September 1.
facts.sourceQuote: 澎湖及金門航線已規劃第二波加班機及放大機型，並將於9月1日(週二)上午9時起統一開放訂位

facts.claim: The second wave of extra flights and expanded aircraft capacity will provide 1,016 seats on Penghu routes and 2,528 seats on Kinmen routes, totaling 3,544 seats.
facts.sourceQuote: 其中澎湖航線提供1,016個座位數，金門航線提供2,528個座位數，總計提供3,544個座位數

facts.claim: Regular flights and the first wave of extra flights for Double Tenth holiday offshore routes were opened for booking on August 10.
facts.sourceQuote: 今年雙十節離島管制航線(澎湖、金門、馬祖)已於8月10日開放正班機及第一波加班機訂位

facts.claim: Tickets for flights departing Taiwan for offshore islands from October 8 to 10 and returning from October 10 to 12 will carry restrictions limiting use to the designated date and flight.
facts.sourceQuote: 於尖峰時段10月8日至10月10日臺灣出發往離島方向，以及10月10日至10月12日離島出發回臺灣方向之機票，均會加註「限當日當班次」、「逾期作廢」之使用限制

facts.claim: Restricted tickets during peak periods will follow a tiered refund fee system divided into three time-frame stages based on flight departure date.
facts.sourceQuote: 並實施「退票費用分級制」。 旅客購買上述加註使用限制之機票，航空公司將依航班起飛日分為前七日以上、前一日至六日及當日航班起飛前等三階段

facts.claim: The CAA reminded passengers to complete ticketing within the airline's deadline to ensure their rights and facilitate capacity management.
facts.sourceQuote: 提醒旅客應依航空公司開票期限完成開票，以確保自身權益
